name: Ant Inbound

function.name: lookup_by_claim_number
function.description: Resolves ANY of these reference numbers to a job: AHS claim number, ServicePower dispatch number, HCP work order number ('WO number'), or Ant internal job_id. Pass whatever number the caller gives you. Returns job + customer + tech.

claim_or_dispatch_number.description: Any of: claim number, dispatch number, HCP work order number (e.g. '22818', '22280-3'), or Ant internal job_id. No spaces.

function.name: get_job_status_for_warranty
function.description: WARRANTY CSC MODE — compact status snapshot for a job_id. Call after lookup_by_claim_number for 'what is the status?' questions.

function.name: get_parts_status
function.description: WARRANTY CSC MODE — parts order details for 'when are parts coming?' questions.

function.name: get_schedule_history
function.description: WARRANTY CSC MODE — scheduling events history for 'why was this rescheduled?' questions.

function.name: get_customer_communications
function.description: WARRANTY CSC MODE — SMS/call history with homeowner for 'have you contacted them?' questions.

function.name: lookup_customer_by_phone
function.description: HOMEOWNER MODE — resolves caller phone (from caller ID) to customer + open jobs + last call. Always your first tool in homeowner mode.

function.name: get_job_arrival_status
function.description: HOMEOWNER MODE — where's my tech? Returns en route status, ETA. Call when homeowner asks status of today's appointment.

function.name: initiate_customer_reschedule
function.description: HOMEOWNER MODE — texts customer 3 A/B/C reschedule slot options. Use when they need to move their appointment.

function.name: start_new_intake
function.description: HOMEOWNER MODE — creates new job after confirming first_name, phone, zip, appliance, problem. Channel must be 'voice'.

function.name: check_service_zone
function.description: HOMEOWNER MODE — checks zip coverage. Call BEFORE start_new_intake for new customers.

function.name: search_customers
function.description: Search customers by name or phone. Use when lookup_customer_by_phone returns found:false AND the caller can't give you a claim number — ask for their name and search. Returns up to 25 matches. If multiple, ask for more detail (city, last name) to narrow.

query.description: Name or phone-style query. e.g. 'Sarah Johnson', 'Smith', '6154855795'

function.name: voice_followup_send_links
function.description: HOMEOWNER MODE — texts customer the portal link (uploads photos + video work through the portal too). ALWAYS ASK PERMISSION before calling. Use after new intake or when offering to share status link with an existing customer.

function.name: voice_capture_call_notes
function.description: Captures anything you learned during the call back to the job (brand, model, serial, access notes, additional context, parts intel). Call near end of any homeowner call OR after a CSC call that surfaced actionable info. Only fills BLANK fields — never overwrites human-supplied values.

brand.description: Appliance brand if mentioned (Whirlpool, Kenmore, etc.)

model_number.description: If customer read it off the sticker

additional_notes.description: Free-text anything useful for office/tech (e.g. 'customer mentioned the leak is from the freezer drawer', 'CSC said they're escalating')

parts_intel.description: If customer named a likely failed part or what previous tech said

firstMessage: Thanks for calling TN Appliance Exchange, this is Ant's assistant — how can I help you today?
voicemailMessage: You've reached Ant at TN Appliance Exchange. Leave a message and we'll get back to you right away — or text us at six-one-five, two-eight-zero, two-nine-four-nine.
endCallMessage: Thanks for calling. Talk to you soon.
